question: Which of the following terms is NOT associated with hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Run out .__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Run out means **to finish, use, or sell all of something, so that there is none left**
 
• Run out in sports means **a method of dismissal in cricket, governed by Law 38 of the Laws of Cricket**
 
• A run out generally happens when the **batsmen are attempting to run in the middle of the wickets, and the fielding team succeed in getting the ball** to one wicket prior to a batsman has traveled across the crease line near the wicket.

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **scoop** is an aerial pass on the dribble from the left edge of the play ground.
 
• The **Flick **action involves a **player crouching low down next to the ball and picking it up on the shaft of the hockey stick**. 
 
• The** Hit **where a **player drives the shoulder, upper arm and hip and elbow, equally into the opponent to separate him from the puck, using the body to knock an opponent against the boards or to the ice**.

5d
